interactions.name: Primary input
interactions.trigger: Pointer activation of the demonstrated primary control
interactions.response: The product advances from the entry surface into the task
interactions.cancellation: Move away without activating the control
interactions.failure: No activation leaves the entry state unchanged
interactions.recovery: Return to the visible control and activate it

interactions.name: Focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Select the demonstrated item, field, or workspace target
interactions.response: The target becomes the active context
interactions.feedback: Selection styling or an active detail surface is visible
interactions.failure: An unselected target does not advance the workflow

interactions.name: Navigation
interactions.response: The central product surface changes while application context remains
interactions.feedback: Destination content replaces the prior surface
interactions.failure: A wrong destination shows content unrelated to the goal
interactions.recovery: Navigate back to the demonstrated destination

interactions.name: Configuration
interactions.trigger: Enter or choose the demonstrated task parameters
interactions.response: The product reflects the configured values
interactions.feedback: The in-progress state exposes the chosen configuration
interactions.cancellation: Remove or replace the current choice
interactions.failure: An incomplete configuration cannot produce the shown result

interactions.name: Confirmation
interactions.trigger: Activate the demonstrated commit, create, run, send, or save action
interactions.feedback: The surface transitions toward the result
interactions.cancellation: Back out before the commit action
interactions.failure: Committing with the task incomplete leaves a no-result state
interactions.recovery: Complete the required context and confirm again

interactions.name: Backtracking
interactions.trigger: Return from the current detail or configuration surface
interactions.response: The previous product context is restored
interactions.failure: Leaving too early abandons the pending result
interactions.recovery: Re-enter the demonstrated task from the restored context

interactions.name: System feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after the demonstrated committed action
interactions.response: The first meaningful result becomes visible
interactions.feedback: Result content replaces or augments the in-progress state
interactions.cancellation: No cancellation is shown after completion
interactions.failure: Stopping before feedback provides no completion evidence
interactions.recovery: Wait for the visible result state

interactions.name: Failure and recovery
interactions.trigger: Attempt to proceed without the demonstrated selection or context
interactions.response: The workflow remains incomplete rather than reaching the result
interactions.feedback: The expected result state is absent
interactions.cancellation: Return to the preceding stable surface
interactions.recovery: Restore the demonstrated context and repeat the confirmed action

motion_analysis.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: this is an official Microsoft screen recording of Power BI Desktop on Windows that plays itself. Inside it the pointer is driven for the viewer — it rests beside "Get data" in the welcome dialog at 15-17s, presses "Load sample data" at 48.0-48.5s, and opens the ribbon's Data Type list at 85.5-86.5s — and red editorial annotations are drawn over the recording (a red rule next to "Get data" at 15-17s, a red rectangle around the ribbon's Data group at ~18s).
motion_analysis.start_state: White Microsoft four-square splash on the Windows desktop (0-3s), which becomes the "Untitled - Power BI Desktop" window carrying the Power BI Desktop welcome dialog (about 4-17.5s).
motion_analysis.end_state: Power Query Editor with the Units Sold column converted and highlighted, Queries [1] listing "financials", and APPLIED STEPS Source / Navigation / Changed Type in the Query Settings pane (88-90s).
motion_analysis.continuity: One 90.03s recording at 30 fps (2701 frames), continuous within each scene rather than cut together: the welcome dialog disappears between 17.5s and 18.0s to uncover the empty "Add data to your report" canvas, a "Connecting" progress modal appears and clears between 49.0s and 50.0s, and the Navigator dialog opens empty at 50.5s ("No items selected for preview") then populates its tree "Financial Sample.xlsx [2]" > financials, Sheet1 by 51.0s and its preview grid of financials rows by 54s. No still-image interpolation.
motion_analysis.interruption_or_reversal: The Power BI Desktop welcome dialog is dismissed between 17.5s and 18.0s, uncovering the empty report canvas behind it, and is never reopened. At 87.0-87.5s the "Change Column Type" prompt offers "Replace current", "Add new step" and "Cancel" for an existing type conversion; the recording takes the replace path, so no cancellation, undo or back-navigation is performed anywhere in the clip.
motion_analysis.feedback: Every committed action draws a visible answer in the same frame: pressing "Load sample data" at 48.5s closes the modal and raises a "Connecting" progress modal with a Cancel button at 49.5s; checking the financials item in the Navigator fills the preview grid with rows (54-66s); the Power Query status bar reports "16 COLUMNS, 700 ROWS" with "Column profiling based on top 1000 rows" and "PREVIEW DOWNLOADED AT 10:39 AM" (state-03 at 75.6s); and each transform appends a named entry to APPLIED STEPS (Source, Navigation, Changed Type).

observations: The welcome dialog's entry points are written out as text beside their glyphs — "Get data", "Recent sources", "Open other reports" — rather than being icon-only (media/state-01-entry.jpg, 14.405s).

Dataset scale is carried as numerals in the Power Query status bar, "16 COLUMNS, 700 ROWS" with "Column profiling based on top 1000 rows", so it reads from the still frame without any animation (media/state-03-result.jpg, 75.628s).

The active column is marked by a persistent visual state, not by motion: in media/state-03-result.jpg the Segment header is filled yellow with a teal underline while the other headers stay dark-grey on white, and the ribbon simultaneously reads "Data Type: Text" as a text label for that selection.

In the welcome dialog's dark navigation crop of media/state-01-entry.jpg (x 90-215, y 55-160) the brightest 2% of pixels (238,238,238) against the darkest 2% (26,26,24) measure a 15.02:1 luminance contrast ratio, and the modal-title crop of media/state-02-progress.jpg (x 208-335, y 98-112) measures 6.1:1 for (98,98,98) title text on (255,255,255) white. Both computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula over the retained JPEGs.

State remains legible with the animation stopped: query name, column headers, row numbers, the APPLIED STEPS transform list and the modal button labels "Replace current" / "Add new step" / "Cancel" (87.0s) are all on-screen text.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, and live-region announcements were not exposed by the static-source recording.
Complete keyboard traversal and focus order were not established by the recording.
Reduced-motion preference handling and a nonanimated equivalent were not demonstrated.
